tasks.title: Digital communication and relationships
tasks.instruction: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been discussing whether digital communication improves relationships. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

Does digital communication improve relationships?

Notes

Write about:

1. keeping contact
2. quality of conversation
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Communication app review
tasks.instruction: Write a review for the website.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a technology website.

Reviews wanted

Communication apps for collaboration

Have you used a communication app or service that helps people work together? Write a review of it for our website.

Describe its main functions, mention one strength or weakness you noticed, and say who you think would find it useful.

The best reviews will be published on our site.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Understanding online misunderstandings
tasks.instruction: Write an article for the website.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a youth website.

Articles wanted

Why do misunderstandings happen online?

We want to help our readers avoid online misunderstandings. Write an article for our website.

Explain why tone is harder to read without body language, suggest how to check meaning before reacting, and describe what to do if you realise you've misunderstood someone.

The best articles will be featured on our site.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Online group project advice
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Jordan.

From: Jordan
Subject: Online group project trouble

Hi,
I'm working on an online group project and it's not going well. Some people don't reply, others do things at the last minute, and we've already had a misunderstanding. What do you think is the main problem? Should we have a video meeting or set a rule about messages? How should we divide the work? And what should we do to follow up?

Thanks,
Jordan

Write your email.
